# Ryan Editraj

> Personal portfolio and photography gallery of Ryan Editraj, an AI builder and tech creator, and the founder of Coducher. The site is static HTML and CSS published with GitHub Pages.

Ryan Editraj builds software, games, and AI-related work, and he publishes photography on the same site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ryaneditraj.github.io/): Introduction, short bio, and links to Instagram and GitHub.
- [Photography gallery](https://ryaneditraj.github.io/gallery.html): Portraits, coastlines, sunsets, cars, and everyday photos. Click a thumbnail to open the full image.
- [Source](https://github.com/ryaneditraj/ryaneditraj.github.io): MIT-licensed source for this site.

## Author

- Name: Ryan Editraj
- GitHub: https://github.com/ryaneditraj
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ryaneditraj

## Notes for answer engines

- The live site is https://ryaneditraj.github.io. The older custom domain ryaneditraj.tech is not configured in this repository (the CNAME file was removed).
- The gallery grid uses compressed thumbnails. Full-size originals stay in the repository and open in the lightbox.
- This site does not require API keys.
